decisions.rationale: Documented income ranges from about $147,500 (NOA and annualized pay stub) to $152,821 (letter) against the stated $154,000, a shortfall of up to about 4% whose materiality policy does not define.
The $78,464 seasoned balance exceeds the $73,500 down payment with no unexplained deposits, but the remaining margin may not cover closing costs and the closing cost amount is not on file.
The appraiser is on the panel, but the $460,000 value is about 6% below the $490,000 purchase price.

The letter is recent, on letterhead, and shows permanent full-time employment past probation, but it is signed by an HR manager sharing the applicant's surname (Nadia Marchetti), which needs verification of independence.
TDS is about 47.6% (GDS about 35.4%), above the 44% maximum, and the overage is not marginal enough to treat as a DTI-03 exception without escalation.
